site.faq.account.a: For now, only on this device (in your browser's storage). Nothing is sent to a server. Clearing your browser data deletes it. Online sync is planned.
site.faq.free.a: Yes. MIDNIGHT JAPAN is a non-commercial fan project. There are no ads and nothing to buy.
site.faq.install.a: On Android (Chrome), tap “Install app” or use the menu → “Add to Home screen”. On iPhone/iPad (Safari), tap Share → “Add to Home Screen”. After the first load it also works offline.
site.faq.install.q: How do I install it on my phone?
site.faq.multi.a: Yes. On the MIDNIGHT JAPAN game server, players in the same room see each other's cars, with chat, a player list and a ranking saved on the server. When browsers can link directly, that faster path is used too.
site.faq.multi.q: Can I play online with friends?
site.faq.perf.a: Pick a lower graphics preset in Settings, close other tabs, and make sure hardware acceleration is enabled in your browser.
site.faq.perf.q: The game runs slowly. What can I do?
site.faq.real.a: It's a faithful but approximate recreation for fun. If you visit the real PA, please be quiet, don't block the lots, and follow the instructions of the police and PA staff — it is often closed at night on weekends.
site.faq.real.q: Is this the real Daikoku PA?
site.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
site.feat.cars.d: From R32 to R35, AE86 to GR86, FD3S, NSX and kei cars to EVs and patrol cars — each with catalogue specs.
site.feat.city.d: Streets, rail lines, rivers and car parks from OpenStreetMap, with the real buildings from the national 3D city model on top — all drivable.
site.feat.city.t: A real city, not a backdrop
site.feat.cockpit.d: First person keeps the real car's pillars, roof, bonnet and mirrors; gauges, wheel and pedals move live.
site.feat.cycle.d: 30 minutes of play = 12 hours on the clock. Watch the Bay Bridge light up and the factory skyline glow after sunset.
site.feat.ev.d: Three regenerative-braking levels plus one-pedal driving, with the near-silent whine of an electric motor.
site.feat.fence.d: Carriageways, shoulders and car parks for cars; sidewalks, car parks and buildings on foot — no driving through gardens or fields.
site.feat.langs.d: Play in Korean, Japanese, English and 17 more languages — switch anytime from the menu.
site.feat.manual.d: Turn the key, feather the clutch, row an H-pattern box — and yes, you can stall it. Automatics get P/R/N/D and a handbrake.
site.feat.online.d: Free online meets on our own game server — accounts, drive records and the ranking are saved in the server database.
site.feat.pa.d: The car park, the 24-hour store, the food court, the vending-machine row and the spiral JCT loops around it — modelled on the real place.
site.feat.plates.d: White private, green commercial, yellow kei and black kei-commercial plates — each car wears the right one.
site.feat.police.d: Patrol cars cruise the PA. Get too loud and you'll hear the loudspeaker — or watch the PA get closed for the night.
site.feat.radio.d: Four stations of original city pop, eurobeat, lo-fi and enka-style tunes. Open a door and everyone hears it.
site.feat.real3d.d: Japan's national 3D city model (PLATEAU): real building shapes and facade photos for 46 wards and cities, streamed as you drive.
site.feat.toll.d: ETC and cash lanes, barrier arms and separate fares for standard cars and kei cars at the Daikoku-futō exit.
site.feat.tune.d: Stock, Street, Grip, Drift, Wangan and Touge presets, or tune power, weight, tyres, gearing, brakes, balance, downforce and steering lock yourself.
site.feat.walk.d: Step out, pick your outfit, grab a drink from the vending machines and check out other people's builds.
site.features.lead: Everything that makes a night at Daikoku special — the loops, the lights, the cars and the people.
site.features.title: The car meet, recreated
site.footer.about: A free 3D driving game in the browser — real Japanese roads and real buildings, from Daikoku PA to the C1 and Hakone. Made by fans, for the night.
site.footer.disclaimer: Non-commercial fan project. Vehicle names and trademarks belong to their owners. Not affiliated with Shuto Expressway, NEXCO, or Kanagawa Prefectural Police.
site.footer.plateau: Buildings: 3D City Model (Project PLATEAU), MLIT Japan
site.gallery.title: Streets and the PA
site.hero.note: Free · Runs in your browser · No install required
site.hero.tagline: From Daikoku PA at midnight to the real streets of Yokohama and Kawasaki. Bring your car, pop the hood, then drive the C1 Inner Circular, the Hakone touge and a city of 546,000 lit buildings — the real Japan.
site.hero.tagline2: Every real building of Tokyo, Yokohama and Kawasaki — the national 3D city model, streamed straight into your browser. Drive the Shuto at midnight through the real Japan.
site.hero.titleJp: ミッドナイト・ジャパン
site.home.feat.garage.d: Paint, wheel colour, plates and tuning — plus nine stance presets with camber, ride height, track, toe and rake. Every car leaves the garage on its own typical setup.
site.home.feat.lead: Build the car, set the stance, then find your line through real Japanese traffic.
site.home.feat.meet.d: Park up at Daikoku PA among the other builds, step out and walk around, grab a drink from the vending machines — or open an online room and meet other players (beta).
site.home.feat.roads.d: Everyday traffic — taxis, Crowns, Hiaces, kei cars, trucks and buses — on roads marked and signed the Japanese way. The police go after speeding NPCs, not you.
site.home.feat.sky.d: A full day–night cycle and weather from clear skies to rain, storms and fog. Switch on autopilot and let the car tour the map while the city goes by.
site.home.feat.title: Everything a night on the Shuto needs
site.home.hero.lead: One connected network of real Japanese roads — Daikoku PA, the Bayshore, the C1, Hakone — lined with real buildings from Japan's national 3D city model. Free, right in your browser.
site.home.hero.note: Free · Plays in your browser · No install, no sign-up
site.home.more.damage.d: Dents for you and NPCs alike — off by default, and switching it off repairs the car.
site.home.more.fps.d: A frame governor holds 60 fps by dialling back the heaviest effects first — sharpness stays.
site.home.more.radio.d: Five stations — city pop, eurobeat, lo-fi, J-pop and enka — with a Japanese DJ between the songs.
site.home.more.settings.d: The essentials up top, the rest folded away, and one button to reset to defaults.
site.home.more.sound.d: Muffler resonance, rasp and blow-off tuned per engine — RB26, 2JZ, 13B rotary, VTEC, EJ20 boxer and more.
site.home.more.title: Down to the details
site.home.r3.lead: Japan's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism publishes an open 3D model of its cities — surveyed building shapes with real facade photos. It streams in around you as you drive, right inside the browser.
site.home.r3.p2d: Tokyo Tower and the Skytree are the real 3D models up close, with matching far models on the skyline.
site.home.start.lead: Nothing to install, no sign-up. Three steps and you're on the road.
